scenario: Rules that form no cycle compile and run correctly per LCYC.1.1. A chain A→B→C (each rule emits the next schema) fires in topological order.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema B scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema C scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule a_to_b:
    A a
->
    emit B logical v: a.v

rule b_to_c:
    B b
->
    emit C logical v: b.v
